## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

WatchDestination / WatchRaceNavigator — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/WatchDestination.kt and app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/WatchRaceNavigator.kt

## Trigger

App start on the watch, before any race navigation happens.

## Today

`WatchDestination` only lists HOME, PREPARATION, MAIN, PROJECTION,
CONTROL and END. `WatchRaceNavigator.current` is initialised
unconditionally to `WatchDestination.HOME`. `SensorPermissionScreen`
(driven by `SensorPermissionViewModel`) and `WaitingForPhoneScreen`
(driven by `WaitingForPhoneViewModel`, which observes
`ProfileRepository` for `lastSyncSuccessAt`) both exist and each works
on its own, but nothing calls either of them from the navigator or
from any composition root: there is no file wiring `HomeScreen`,
`SensorPermissionScreen` and `WaitingForPhoneScreen` together, and no
`MainActivity` or equivalent entry point exists under
app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear.

## Expected

`WatchDestination` carries a state for the sensor permission screen
and one for the waiting-for-phone screen. At first launch,
`WatchRaceNavigator` (or the entry point that creates it) picks among
the permission screen, the waiting-for-phone screen and the home
screen — based on whether sensor permission is already granted and
whether a profile has already synced (`ProfileRepository`) — instead
of always starting on HOME.
